claim_boundary: Wave 46 narrows the next controller to UET lattice normalization plus finite-k admissibility for the Cahn-Hilliard structure-factor candidate. It does not accept estimator replacement or rerun scaling claims.

claim_boundary_gate.claim_boundary: Wave 46 maps source formulas to policy lanes and identifies the CH finite-k candidate as the next plausible path; it accepts no estimator or Tier A claim.
claim_boundary_gate.required_condition: Formula mapping narrows the blocker but does not upgrade the topic claim.

conserved_susceptibility_policy_gate.reason: Fixed-magnetization and canonical fragments constrain the policy boundary but do not resolve the conserved-mean S(0) blocker.
conserved_susceptibility_policy_gate.required_condition: A conserved-order connected S(0) or canonical susceptibility policy must be accepted before source-family S(0) estimators can be used.

estimator_policy_acceptance_gate.required_condition: At least one source-mapped policy row must set accepted_for_estimator_policy_now true before exponent gates rerun.

finite_k_policy_candidate_gate.claim_boundary: WARN is intentional: candidate source formulas exist, but acceptance gates remain blocked.
finite_k_policy_candidate_gate.required_condition: The Cahn-Hilliard source lane may be treated as a candidate finite-k formula family, not an accepted estimator.

missing_rules: allowed q modes or q band for L16/L20 and future grids
nondeclining absolute-length trend requirement under the accepted estimator
finite_size_admissibility_gate.required_condition: Accepted finite-k estimator use requires a finite-size q-window and domain-scale saturation guard.

fragment_coverage_gate.required_condition: All three source lanes and the expected 19 extracted fragments must be present.

next_artifacts_required: UET lattice normalization table for C, delta-c, q, S(q,t), and xi
finite-k admissibility rule with domain-scale guard
accepted estimator implementation that is not the rejected RMS inverse-k proxy
finite-size/exponent rerun using the accepted estimator
next_path_gate.required_condition: Do not rerun exponent, universality, material, or Tier A gates until normalization and admissibility pass.

policy_mapping_manifest_gate.required_condition: A normalization-map manifest must map each source lane to a policy lane and explicit missing requirements.

missing_mapping: M, kappa, L, K, Delta T, and chi(q=0) coefficient mapping
uet_normalization_mapping_gate.required_condition: An accepted source formula must be mapped into UET lattice units before scaling or exponent gates may rerun.

wave43_chain_gate.required_condition: Wave 46 requires Wave 43 fresh formula extraction from repo archives.

wave44_archive_gate.required_condition: Repo source archives must remain available before source-formula mapping is reproducible.

limitations: The restored TeX fragments are mapped to policy lanes, but no estimator is accepted.
The Cahn-Hilliard S(q,t) lane is the strongest candidate path, but it lacks UET lattice normalization and q-window admissibility.
Fixed-magnetization and canonical susceptibility fragments constrain policy boundaries but do not resolve the conserved-mean S(0) blocker.
No finite-size/exponent, material, RG, universality, or Tier A claim may be upgraded from this mapping gate.
